title.tagline: A raccoon, some crickets, and a very good pile of garbage.
map.title: The Alley
intro.1-1: That pile behind the sprinkler? It's ours. Send the crickets!
intro.1-2: Two sprinklers tonight. Keep the crickets coming.
intro.1-3: A neighbor with a broom! Possum doesn't mind a little sweeping.
intro.1-4: Bigger pile, busier alley. Mix it up!
intro.1-5: The best pile in the whole alley. Everybody, go!
tutorial.card: Tap the crickets to send them!
tutorial.again: Keep sending! Hold to send lots.
pause.title: Paused
results.title: The pile is ours!
night.title: The sun's coming up — time for a nap.

intro.2-1: Back yards! The dog only guards one path. Pick the other one.
intro.2-2: Two dogs on top. Squirrels are too quick for them!
intro.2-3: Brooms on both paths. Possums don't mind a sweep!
intro.2-4: A motion light! Crows fly right over the dogs.
intro.2-5: The biggest back yard pile. Everybody, go!
intro.3-1: Welcome to the cul-de-sac. Fancy lawns, fancy garbage.
intro.3-2: A fence! Rats can chew through it, and crows fly over.
intro.3-3: Three paths! Each one has its own trouble.
intro.3-4: Fences on both sides. Bring the rats!
intro.3-5: The cul-de-sac's grandest pile. Use every friend!
intro.4-1: The dumpster lot behind the strip mall. Smells amazing.
intro.4-3: Brooms and dogs everywhere. Mix up your troupe!
intro.4-4: Fences on every path! Rats to the front.
intro.4-5: The biggest pile in the whole city. This is it, everybody!
